hook: Is drinking fruit juice for breakfast actually healthy or a metabolic trap?
caption:
Fruit juice tagadam healthy anukuntన్నారా? 🤔

Juice chesinappudu fruits lo unde primary fiber poyi, refined fructose matrame miguluthundi. Idhi blood sugar 📈 spike chesi morning fatigue ki karanam avuthundi.

✨ Practical Habit Swap:
Juice ki badulu fresh whole fruits tinandi! Fiber retention valla digestion slow ga avvi energy steady ga untundi.

Save this reel & share with your family! ❤️

poster_caption:
Are you accidentally sabotaging your energy before 9 AM? 🍳

Many popular 'health foods' are actually disguised sugar bombs that trigger massive glucose spikes and morning brain fog.

Here is what to avoid:
• Orange juice (stripped of fiber, pure sugar)
• Plain toast (causes rapid insulin spikes)
• Sweetened cereal (ultra-processed dessert)
